name: Hereditary Sensory Neuropathy Type II
aliases: Hereditary Sensory and Autonomic Neuropathy Type II

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and Genetic Diagnostic Criteria for Hereditary Sensory Neuropathy Type II

criteria.description: Progressive distal loss of pain and temperature sensation
Presence of distal limb ulcerations and painless injuries
Identification of pathogenic mutations in relevant genes (e.g., WNK1/HSN2)
Reduced or absent deep tendon reflexes in affected limbs
Preserved motor strength with predominant sensory involvement

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of progressive distal loss of pain and temperature sensation plus distal limb ulcerations, confirmed by genetic testing
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is supported by clinical presentation and confirmed by molecular genetic testing.

searchTerms: loss of pain sensation in extremities
can't feel pain in hands and feet
can't feel cold or heat in extremities
loss of temperature sensation in hands/feet
numbness to hot and cold in limbs
ulcers on hands and feet without pain

common.symptomName: Distal sensory loss to light touch
searchTerms: can't feel light touch in fingers/toes
loss of gentle touch sensation distally
numbness to soft touch in extremities

common.symptomName: Reduced or absent deep tendon reflexes

searchTerms: muscle shrinking in hands and feet
loss of muscle bulk in fingers and toes

common.symptomName: Hypohidrosis or anhidrosis in affected areas
searchTerms: reduced or no sweating in areas
dry skin due to lack of sweat
inability to sweat in affected regions

occasional.symptomName: Painless fractures due to sensory loss

searchTerms: mild weakness in hands and feet
burning or shooting pain from nerves

laboratory: Nerve conduction studies showing absent or reduced sensory nerve action potentials
Normal or mildly reduced motor nerve conduction velocities
imaging: X-rays showing bone resorption or Charcot arthropathy in distal limbs
genetic: Mutations in other genes associated with hereditary sensory neuropathies
other: Skin biopsy showing loss of small myelinated and unmyelinated fibers

distinguishingFeatures: Symmetric distal sensory loss with pain

redFlags: Signs of systemic infection in ulcerations
